fields.topic: Flexure reference sizes and statistical meanings
fields.finding: SA sources report m=10 and m=8; catalogue 380 MPa is typical rather than explicitly a fitted mean. Bend spans are absent. Commercial CVD reports m=11, scale 424 MPa and mean 415 MPa but no specimen dimensions.
fields.needed: Applicable product revision, specimen spans and orientation, sample sizes, raw data, finish, fit definition and uncertainty. Clarify the CVD mean/scale relationship without replacing the reported scale.
fields.effect: SA 40/20 mm spans and mean-to-scale conversions remain PROJECTION. Commercial CVD has no justified full-size probability here.
